review_kind: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5), no native-speaker signoff
note: Instruction 316, maintainer decision 2026-09-25: runtime (GUI) translation debt written and technically reviewed by AI against the English source and its code context. No human and no native speaker has read these rows.

records.key: A logarithmic curve on 0..1, log(1 + gain x) / log(1 + gain): it compresses the bright end and lifts the dim one, more strongly near zero than a gamma below 1.
records.source: A logarithmic curve on 0..1, log(1 + gain x) / log(1 + gain): it compresses the bright end and lifts the dim one, more strongly near zero than a gamma below 1.
records.translation: 0..1 上的对数曲线 log(1 + gain x) / log(1 + gain)：它压缩亮端并提亮暗端，在接近零处比低于 1 的伽马更强。

records.key: A square-root curve on 0..1, the curve a gamma of 0.5 draws: it lifts the dim end.
records.source: A square-root curve on 0..1, the curve a gamma of 0.5 draws: it lifts the dim end.
records.translation: 0..1 上的平方根曲线，即伽马为 0.5 时的曲线：它会提亮暗端。

records.key: Add a filter for any regionprop scikit-image measures. The list applies as you edit it and when a field opens; each object it hides is listed below, and removing a row brings back what it hid.
records.source: Add a filter for any regionprop scikit-image measures. The list applies as you edit it and when a field opens; each object it hides is listed below, and removing a row brings back what it hid.
records.translation: 为 scikit-image 测量的任意 regionprop 添加过滤器。列表会在编辑时以及打开视野时应用；它隐藏的每个对象都会列在下方，移除某一行即可恢复该行隐藏的对象。

records.key: Add a row for the property on the left, with a minimum and a maximum. A blank bound is off; an object outside a bound is hidden, and removing the row brings it back.
records.source: Add a row for the property on the left, with a minimum and a maximum. A blank bound is off; an object outside a bound is hidden, and removing the row brings it back.
records.translation: 为左侧的属性添加一行，包含最小值和最大值。留空的界限表示不限制；超出界限的对象会被隐藏，移除该行即可恢复。

records.key: Apply the filter list to the mask on screen again. Every object it hides is listed below it, with the value that hid it. One undo step.
records.source: Apply the filter list to the mask on screen again. Every object it hides is listed below it, with the value that hid it. One undo step.
records.translation: 将过滤器列表重新应用于当前显示的掩膜。它隐藏的每个对象都会列在其下方，并附上导致隐藏的数值。可一步撤销。

records.key: Cellpose 4 with Meta's DINOv3 backbone, which runs the Cellpose-DINO models (ViT-L and ViT-B) listed from bioimage.io. It runs in an environment of its own, so spaCR's own Cellpose is untouched; its masks, flows and cell probability come back in Cellpose-SAM's shapes.
records.source: Cellpose 4 with Meta's DINOv3 backbone, which runs the Cellpose-DINO models (ViT-L and ViT-B) listed from bioimage.io. It runs in an environment of its own, so spaCR's own Cellpose is untouched; its masks, flows and cell probability come back in Cellpose-SAM's shapes.
records.translation: Cellpose 4 搭配 Meta 的 DINOv3 主干网络，用于运行从 bioimage.io 列出的 Cellpose-DINO 模型（ViT-L 和 ViT-B）。它在独立环境中运行，因此 spaCR 自身的 Cellpose 不受影响；其掩膜、流场和细胞概率以 Cellpose-SAM 的形状返回。

records.key: Cellpose 4.2.1.1 is BSD-3-Clause (Copyright 2025 Howard Hughes Medical Institute). DINOv3 is NOT open source: its code and weights are Meta's DINO Materials under the DINOv3 License (github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3, LICENSE.md, 19 August 2025), which binds whoever uses them, so installing this backend and running a Cellpose-DINO model is agreeing to it. It allows use, copying and modification; it requires that anything passed on carries the licence, that a publication using the results acknowledges DINOv3, and it forbids military, weapons, nuclear and espionage uses and anyone under trade sanctions. Cellpose-DINO checkpoints are DINOv3 fine-tuned by the Cellpose authors, so the same terms reach them whatever licence their page names. spaCR ships none of it: dinov3 is fetched from Meta's GitHub at commit 6876159a11b4, and each checkpoint from the page it is listed on.
records.source: Cellpose 4.2.1.1 is BSD-3-Clause (Copyright 2025 Howard Hughes Medical Institute). DINOv3 is NOT open source: its code and weights are Meta's DINO Materials under the DINOv3 License (github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3, LICENSE.md, 19 August 2025), which binds whoever uses them, so installing this backend and running a Cellpose-DINO model is agreeing to it. It allows use, copying and modification; it requires that anything passed on carries the licence, that a publication using the results acknowledges DINOv3, and it forbids military, weapons, nuclear and espionage uses and anyone under trade sanctions. Cellpose-DINO checkpoints are DINOv3 fine-tuned by the Cellpose authors, so the same terms reach them whatever licence their page names. spaCR ships none of it: dinov3 is fetched from Meta's GitHub at commit 6876159a11b4, and each checkpoint from the page it is listed on.
records.translation: Cellpose 4.2.1.1 采用 BSD-3-Clause 许可（Copyright 2025 Howard Hughes Medical Institute）。DINOv3 不是开源软件：其代码和权重属于 Meta 的 DINO Materials，受 DINOv3 License 约束（github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3，LICENSE.md，2025 年 8 月 19 日），该许可约束所有使用者，因此安装此后端并运行 Cellpose-DINO 模型即表示同意该许可。它允许使用、复制和修改；要求任何再分发的内容都附带该许可，使用其结果的出版物须致谢 DINOv3；并禁止军事、武器、核及间谍用途，也禁止受贸易制裁的任何人使用。Cellpose-DINO 检查点是由 Cellpose 作者微调的 DINOv3，因此无论其页面标注何种许可，同样的条款都适用于它们。spaCR 不附带其中任何内容：dinov3 从 Meta 的 GitHub 的提交 6876159a11b4 获取，每个检查点则从其所列页面获取。

records.key: Choose the camera, to fill its physical pixel pitch. Common sCMOS cameras have 6.5 µm pixels; the image pixel size is this pitch divided by the magnification. Default 6.5 µm.
records.source: Choose the camera, to fill its physical pixel pitch. Common sCMOS cameras have 6.5 µm pixels; the image pixel size is this pitch divided by the magnification. Default 6.5 µm.
records.translation: 选择相机以填入其物理像素间距。常见的 sCMOS 相机像素为 6.5 µm；图像像素尺寸等于该间距除以放大倍数。默认值 6.5 µm。

records.key: Choose the fluorophore, to fill a typical emission wavelength: DAPI 461 nm, GFP 520 nm, Cy3 600 nm, Cy5 670 nm. A longer wavelength gives a wider PSF. Default GFP, 520 nm.
records.source: Choose the fluorophore, to fill a typical emission wavelength: DAPI 461 nm, GFP 520 nm, Cy3 600 nm, Cy5 670 nm. A longer wavelength gives a wider PSF. Default GFP, 520 nm.
records.translation: 选择荧光团以填入典型的发射波长：DAPI 461 nm、GFP 520 nm、Cy3 600 nm、Cy5 670 nm。波长越长，PSF 越宽。默认值 GFP，520 nm。

records.key: Choose the microscope objective the images were taken with. Its magnification, numerical aperture and immersion fill the optics below, which then give the image pixel size (camera pixel divided by magnification) and the Gaussian width (0.51 × emission wavelength / NA). Default 20× / NA 0.75 air.
records.source: Choose the microscope objective the images were taken with. Its magnification, numerical aperture and immersion fill the optics below, which then give the image pixel size (camera pixel divided by magnification) and the Gaussian width (0.51 × emission wavelength / NA). Default 20× / NA 0.75 air.
records.translation: 选择拍摄图像时使用的显微镜物镜。其放大倍数、数值孔径和浸没介质会填入下方的光学参数，进而得出图像像素尺寸（相机像素除以放大倍数）和高斯宽度（0.51 × 发射波长 / NA）。默认值 20× / NA 0.75 空气。

records.key: Clip the image to two percentiles of its own intensities before the contrast curves, so a hot or dead pixel cannot set the range they are drawn on. Nothing is stretched; intensities keep their units.
records.source: Clip the image to two percentiles of its own intensities before the contrast curves, so a hot or dead pixel cannot set the range they are drawn on. Nothing is stretched; intensities keep their units.
records.translation: 在对比度曲线之前，将图像裁剪到其自身强度的两个百分位数之间，使热像素或坏点无法决定绘制曲线的范围。不做任何拉伸；强度保持原有单位。

records.key: Could not link {name} into {folder} ({why}). Drop the folder that holds the plaque images instead.
records.source: Could not link {name} into {folder} ({why}). Drop the folder that holds the plaque images instead.
records.translation: 无法将 {name} 链接到 {folder}（{why}）。请改为拖入包含蚀斑图像的文件夹。

records.key: Could not read {n} of the papers: {names}.
records.source: Could not read {n} of the papers: {names}.
records.translation: 无法读取 {n} 篇论文：{names}。

records.key: Emission wavelength in nanometers. Changing it recalculates the Gaussian FWHM as 0.51 × wavelength / NA.
records.source: Emission wavelength in nanometers. Changing it recalculates the Gaussian FWHM as 0.51 × wavelength / NA.
records.translation: 发射波长，单位为纳米。更改后会按 0.51 × 波长 / NA 重新计算高斯 FWHM。

records.key: Enhancement chain written to the Mask settings: {steps}.
records.source: Enhancement chain written to the Mask settings: {steps}.
records.translation: 增强链已写入掩膜设置：{steps}。

records.key: Hide objects whose value is above this. Blank is no maximum; an object equal to the bound is kept.
records.source: Hide objects whose value is above this. Blank is no maximum; an object equal to the bound is kept.
records.translation: 隐藏数值高于此值的对象。留空表示无上限；等于界限的对象会保留。

records.key: Hide objects whose value is below this. Blank is no minimum; an object equal to the bound is kept.
records.source: Hide objects whose value is below this. Blank is no minimum; an object equal to the bound is kept.
records.translation: 隐藏数值低于此值的对象。留空表示无下限；等于界限的对象会保留。

records.key: Image pixel spacing in micrometers. Filled from the file's calibration when it has one, otherwise camera pixel / magnification; edit it to override.
records.source: Image pixel spacing in micrometers. Filled from the file's calibration when it has one, otherwise camera pixel / magnification; edit it to override.
records.translation: 图像像素间距，单位为微米。文件带有标定时从中填入，否则按相机像素 / 放大倍数计算；可编辑以覆盖该值。

records.key: Make Masks needs image files, or a folder of images, to fine-tune Cellpose against.
records.source: Make Masks needs image files, or a folder of images, to fine-tune Cellpose against.
records.translation: 创建掩膜 (Make Masks) 需要图像文件或图像文件夹，才能对 Cellpose 进行微调。

records.key: Mask the whole folder works on one folder, and this queue was dropped from several, so it was not started.
records.source: Mask the whole folder works on one folder, and this queue was dropped from several, so it was not started.
records.translation: “为整个文件夹生成掩膜”只处理一个文件夹，而此队列是从多个文件夹拖入的，因此未启动。

records.key: Needs the Cellpose-DINO backend, Cellpose 4 with DINOv3 in an environment of its own, which is not installed — press Install to install it.
records.source: Needs the Cellpose-DINO backend, Cellpose 4 with DINOv3 in an environment of its own, which is not installed — press Install to install it.
records.translation: 需要 Cellpose-DINO 后端，即在独立环境中运行的 Cellpose 4 与 DINOv3，但该后端尚未安装 — 请按“安装”进行安装。

records.key: None of the dropped items is an image Make Masks can open.
records.source: None of the dropped items is an image Make Masks can open.
records.translation: 拖入的项目中没有（None）创建掩膜 (Make Masks) 能打开的图像。

records.key: Nothing is hidden. Add a filter above and set a bound.
records.source: Nothing is hidden. Add a filter above and set a bound.
records.translation: 没有隐藏任何对象。请在上方添加过滤器并设置界限。

records.key: Object filter removed {count} object(s) — Ctrl+Z to undo
records.source: Object filter removed {count} object(s) — Ctrl+Z to undo
records.translation: 对象过滤器移除了 {count} 个对象 — 按 Ctrl+Z 撤销

records.key: Object filters: nothing outside the bounds.
records.source: Object filters: nothing outside the bounds.
records.translation: 对象过滤器：没有超出界限的对象。

records.key: Open spaCR's Mask module to receive the enhancement chain.
records.source: Open spaCR's Mask module to receive the enhancement chain.
records.translation: 请打开 spaCR 的掩膜模块以接收增强链。

records.key: PDFs are read in Figure mode, images in Plaque mode.
records.source: PDFs are read in Figure mode, images in Plaque mode.
records.translation: PDFs 在文献图模式下读取，图像在蚀斑模式下读取。

records.key: Physical camera pixel pitch in micrometers. Divided by the magnification it gives the image pixel size.
records.source: Physical camera pixel pitch in micrometers. Divided by the magnification it gives the image pixel size.
records.translation: 相机的物理像素间距，单位为微米。除以放大倍数即为图像像素尺寸。

records.key: Pixel {pixel} µm ({pixel_source}); FWHM {fwhm} µm ({fwhm_source}); objective {objective}.
records.source: Pixel {pixel} µm ({pixel_source}); FWHM {fwhm} µm ({fwhm_source}); objective {objective}.
records.translation: 像素 {pixel} µm（{pixel_source}）；FWHM {fwhm} µm（{fwhm_source}）；物镜 {objective}。

records.key: Plaque Assay could not start reading this PDF.
records.source: Plaque Assay could not start reading this PDF.
records.translation: Plaque Assay 无法开始读取此 PDF。

records.key: Plaque Assay reads a paper's PDF in Figure mode, and it is in Plaque mode.
records.source: Plaque Assay reads a paper's PDF in Figure mode, and it is in Plaque mode.
records.translation: Plaque Assay 在文献图模式下读取论文 PDF，但当前处于蚀斑模式。

records.key: Plaque Assay reads plaque images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, BMP or WebP), a folder of them, or in Figure mode a paper's PDF.
records.source: Plaque Assay reads plaque images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, BMP or WebP), a folder of them, or in Figure mode a paper's PDF.
records.translation: Plaque Assay 可读取蚀斑图像（JPG、PNG、TIFF、GIF、BMP 或 WebP）、包含这些图像的文件夹，或在文献图模式下读取论文 PDF。

records.key: Published results: none for the DINO backbone yet; Cellpose-SAM is Pachitariu, Rariden and Stringer, bioRxiv 2025 (doi:10.1101/2025.04.28.651001), and DINOv3 is Simeoni et al., arXiv:2508.10104. spaCR has not scored this backend on a benchmark of its own data; one Toxoplasma PV field is measured in item 525.
records.source: Published results: none for the DINO backbone yet; Cellpose-SAM is Pachitariu, Rariden and Stringer, bioRxiv 2025 (doi:10.1101/2025.04.28.651001), and DINOv3 is Simeoni et al., arXiv:2508.10104. spaCR has not scored this backend on a benchmark of its own data; one Toxoplasma PV field is measured in item 525.
records.translation: 已发表结果：DINO 主干网络尚无；Cellpose-SAM 出自 Pachitariu、Rariden 和 Stringer，bioRxiv 2025（doi:10.1101/2025.04.28.651001），DINOv3 出自 Simeoni et al.，arXiv:2508.10104。spaCR 尚未在自有数据的基准上评估此后端；条目 525 中测量了一个弓形虫 PV 视野。

records.key: Read the current image file for OME or ImageJ calibration: pixel size, objective magnification, numerical aperture, immersion and emission wavelength. Whatever the file does not state comes from the objective chosen here and common defaults. Every value stays editable and says where it came from.
records.source: Read the current image file for OME or ImageJ calibration: pixel size, objective magnification, numerical aperture, immersion and emission wavelength. Whatever the file does not state comes from the objective chosen here and common defaults. Every value stays editable and says where it came from.
records.translation: 读取当前图像文件中的 OME 或 ImageJ 标定：像素尺寸、物镜放大倍数、数值孔径、浸没介质和发射波长。文件未注明的内容取自此处选择的物镜和常用默认值。每个值都保持可编辑，并注明其来源。

records.key: Read {k} of {n} papers into {path}: {figures} figures, {m} with legends.
records.source: Read {k} of {n} papers into {path}: {figures} figures, {m} with legends.
records.translation: 已读取 {k}/{n} 篇论文到 {path}：{figures} 幅文献图，其中 {m} 幅带有图注。

records.key: Refractive index of the immersion medium: air 1.0, water 1.33, oil 1.515. The NA cannot exceed it.
records.source: Refractive index of the immersion medium: air 1.0, water 1.33, oil 1.515. The NA cannot exceed it.
records.translation: 浸没介质的折射率：空气 1.0，水 1.33，油 1.515。NA 不能超过此值。

records.key: Reinstalling deletes {name}'s environment, {environment}, and builds it again with what spaCR pins for it now. If it fails, nothing is left and it can be installed again.
records.source: Reinstalling deletes {name}'s environment, {environment}, and builds it again with what spaCR pins for it now. If it fails, nothing is left and it can be installed again.
records.translation: 重新安装会删除 {name} 的环境 {environment}，并按照 spaCR 当前为其锁定的版本重新构建。如果失败，不会留下任何内容，并且可以再次安装。

records.key: Remove this filter. The objects only it was hiding come back.
records.source: Remove this filter. The objects only it was hiding come back.
records.translation: 移除此过滤器。仅由它隐藏的对象会重新显示。

records.key: Runs through the Cellpose 3 backend, which is installed. Choosing it writes cellpose3:{name} into the object's model setting, which runs that object through Cellpose 3 and shows the Cellpose 3 settings in Mask generation.
records.source: Runs through the Cellpose 3 backend, which is installed. Choosing it writes cellpose3:{name} into the object's model setting, which runs that object through Cellpose 3 and shows the Cellpose 3 settings in Mask generation.
records.translation: 通过 Cellpose 3 后端运行，该后端已安装。选择它会将 cellpose3:{name} 写入对象的模型设置，使该对象通过 Cellpose 3 运行，并在掩膜生成中显示 Cellpose 3 设置。

records.key: Runs through the Cellpose 3 backend, which is not installed — press Install to install it.
records.source: Runs through the Cellpose 3 backend, which is not installed — press Install to install it.
records.translation: 通过 Cellpose 3 后端运行，但该后端尚未安装 — 请按“安装”进行安装。

records.key: Runs through the Cellpose-DINO backend, which is installed. Download it, then Use this model writes cellpose_dino:<its path> into the object's model setting, which runs that object through Cellpose-DINO with its usual Mask generation settings.
records.source: Runs through the Cellpose-DINO backend, which is installed. Download it, then Use this model writes cellpose_dino:<its path> into the object's model setting, which runs that object through Cellpose-DINO with its usual Mask generation settings.
records.translation: 通过 Cellpose-DINO 后端运行，该后端已安装。请先下载，然后 Use this model 会将 cellpose_dino:<its path> 写入对象的模型设置，使该对象使用其常规的掩膜生成设置通过 Cellpose-DINO 运行。

records.key: SpotNet's models are licensed for NON-COMMERCIAL ACADEMIC USE ONLY, which is not spaCR's licence.
records.source: SpotNet's models are licensed for NON-COMMERCIAL ACADEMIC USE ONLY, which is not spaCR's licence.
records.translation: SpotNet 的模型仅限非商业学术用途（NON-COMMERCIAL ACADEMIC USE ONLY），这不是 spaCR 的许可证。

records.key: Switch Plaque Assay to Figure mode, then drop the PDF again.
records.source: Switch Plaque Assay to Figure mode, then drop the PDF again.
records.translation: 请将 Plaque Assay 切换到文献图模式，然后再次拖入该 PDF。

records.key: The lower percentile of the clip, 0 to 100, below the upper.
records.source: The lower percentile of the clip, 0 to 100, below the upper.
records.translation: 裁剪的下限百分位数，0 到 100，低于上限。

records.key: The objective NA, engraved on its barrel. Changing it recalculates the Gaussian FWHM as 0.51 × emission wavelength / NA.
records.source: The objective NA, engraved on its barrel. Changing it recalculates the Gaussian FWHM as 0.51 × emission wavelength / NA.
records.translation: 物镜的 NA，刻在物镜镜筒上。更改后会按 0.51 × 发射波长 / NA 重新计算高斯 FWHM。

records.key: The plaque figure reader needs reinstalling before it can read PDFs: {why}
records.source: The plaque figure reader needs reinstalling before it can read PDFs: {why}
records.translation: 蚀斑文献图读取器需要重新安装后才能读取 PDFs：{why}

records.key: The regionprop this row judges each object by, measured once per mask together with every other row.
records.source: The regionprop this row judges each object by, measured once per mask together with every other row.
records.translation: 此行用于评判每个对象的 regionprop，每个掩膜与其他所有行一起测量一次。

records.key: The scikit-image regionprop the next filter row judges objects by. Intensity statistics are listed only while an image is open, since they read the raw pixel values.
records.source: The scikit-image regionprop the next filter row judges objects by. Intensity statistics are listed only while an image is open, since they read the raw pixel values.
records.translation: 下一行过滤器用于评判对象的 scikit-image regionprop。强度统计量仅在打开图像时列出，因为它们读取原始像素值。

records.key: The upper percentile of the clip, 0 to 100, above the lower.
records.source: The upper percentile of the clip, 0 to 100, above the lower.
records.translation: 裁剪的上限百分位数，0 到 100，高于下限。

records.key: Total magnification between specimen and camera, including any camera adapter. Changing it recalculates the image pixel size unless the pixel size was read from the file or entered.
records.source: Total magnification between specimen and camera, including any camera adapter. Changing it recalculates the image pixel size unless the pixel size was read from the file or entered.
records.translation: 样品与相机之间的总放大倍数，包括任何相机适配器。更改后会重新计算图像像素尺寸，除非像素尺寸是从文件中读取或手动输入的。

records.key: Wait for the paper being read to finish, then drop the PDF again.
records.source: Wait for the paper being read to finish, then drop the PDF again.
records.translation: 请等待正在读取的论文完成，然后再次拖入该 PDF。

records.key: What the filter list hides, one row per object: its id, its area and mean intensity, and each bound that hid it with the value it was judged on. The ids are the ones the hover readout shows.
records.source: What the filter list hides, one row per object: its id, its area and mean intensity, and each bound that hid it with the value it was judged on. The ids are the ones the hover readout shows.
records.translation: 过滤器列表所隐藏的内容，每个对象一行：其 ID、面积和平均强度，以及导致隐藏的每个界限及其评判所依据的数值。这些 ID 与悬停读数中显示的 ID 相同。

records.key: What the intensities are multiplied by before the logarithm. Larger compresses the bright end harder.
records.source: What the intensities are multiplied by before the logarithm. Larger compresses the bright end harder.
records.translation: 在对数之前与强度相乘的值。值越大，亮端压缩越强。

records.key: Write the configured chain and PSF into the Mask module's Image Enhancement and Point Spread Function settings, so a plate run applies these steps to every selected channel after illumination correction and before normalization. Morphology and split reshape a detector's labels and stay here.
records.source: Write the configured chain and PSF into the Mask module's Image Enhancement and Point Spread Function settings, so a plate run applies these steps to every selected channel after illumination correction and before normalization. Morphology and split reshape a detector's labels and stay here.
records.translation: 将配置好的增强链和 PSF 写入掩膜模块的“图像增强”和“点扩散函数”设置，使整板运行在光照校正之后、归一化之前将这些步骤应用于每个所选通道。形态学和拆分会重塑检测器的标签，保留在此处。

records.key: spaCR's own spot score, the detector this plate was validated with.
records.source: spaCR's own spot score, the detector this plate was validated with.
records.translation: spaCR 自带的斑点评分，即此板经过验证所用的检测器。

records.key: {magnification}× / NA {aperture} {immersion}
records.source: {magnification}× / NA {aperture} {immersion}

records.key: {name} holds a paper's PDF or its figures. PDFs are read in Figure mode, and Plaque Assay is in Plaque mode.
records.source: {name} holds a paper's PDF or its figures. PDFs are read in Figure mode, and Plaque Assay is in Plaque mode.
records.translation: {name} 包含论文的 PDF 或其文献图。PDFs 在文献图模式下读取，而 Plaque Assay 当前处于蚀斑模式。

records.key: {name} holds images. Plaque images are read in Plaque mode, and Plaque Assay is in Figure mode, which reads published figures.
records.source: {name} holds images. Plaque images are read in Plaque mode, and Plaque Assay is in Figure mode, which reads published figures.
records.translation: {name} 包含图像。蚀斑图像在蚀斑模式下读取，而 Plaque Assay 当前处于文献图模式，该模式读取已发表的文献图。

records.key: {name} holds {pdfs} PDF(s) or paper folder(s) and {images} image(s). Which should Plaque Assay read?
records.source: {name} holds {pdfs} PDF(s) or paper folder(s) and {images} image(s). Which should Plaque Assay read?
records.translation: {name} 包含 {pdfs} 个 PDF 或论文文件夹以及 {images} 幅图像。Plaque Assay 应读取哪一种？

records.key: {name} is a backend, not a checkpoint file. Install it here, then download a Cellpose-DINO model from the bioimage.io heading and press Use this model on it.
records.source: {name} is a backend, not a checkpoint file. Install it here, then download a Cellpose-DINO model from the bioimage.io heading and press Use this model on it.
records.translation: {name} 是计算后端，而不是检查点文件。请在此安装，然后从 bioimage.io 标题下下载一个 Cellpose-DINO 模型，并对其按 Use this model。

records.key: {name} measures pixel values, and no intensity image is open, so it cannot filter this mask.
records.source: {name} measures pixel values, and no intensity image is open, so it cannot filter this mask.
records.translation: {name} 测量像素值，但当前没有打开强度图像，因此无法过滤此掩膜。

records.key: {n} file(s) that are neither images nor PDFs were left aside.
records.source: {n} file(s) that are neither images nor PDFs were left aside.
records.translation: {n} 个既不是图像也不是 PDFs 的文件已被略过。
